detail.overview: Intex 8 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine Designed for Indian households, it features a rust-free body, dual wash programs, roller jet with mini pulsator, and a powerful motor with TOP technology. The hydraulic lid and full toughened glass with flower print add elegance, while practical features like water level adjuster, dual waterfall, and magic filter ensure efficient, deep cleaning every time.
features: Motor: Powerful Motor with TOP Technology
Wash Technology: Roller Jet with Mini Pulsator Design
Lid: Hydraulic Wash Lid with Full Toughened Glass (Flower Design)
Additional Features: Water Level Adjuster, Dual Waterfall
Warranty: 2 Years on Product | 5 Years on Wash Motor
